The brand Sterilamp was registered to Westinghouse Electric & Manufacturing Company on 25 August 1939 (Serial No. 71423019, Registration No. 0375857) for vacuum or gas‑filled tubes used to generate radiation for hastening the tenderisation of meat in showcases and domestic refrigerators.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://tsdr.uspto.gov/#caseNumber=71423019&caseType=SERIAL_NO&searchType=statusSearch|title=Trademark Serial No. 71423019 — Sterilamp|publisher=USPTO Trademark Status and Document Retrieval|access-date=2026-06-21}}</ref>

SUMMARY: Added trademark information for Sterilamp with USPTO citation.
